title: Vendor-oracle receipt (interchange) (vendor-oracle-receipt-v1)
description: External-lab -> core interchange contract for a real platform zic run over the diagnostic-fixture corpus; admission is recomputed by the core (admit()), never trusted from the receipt's self-assessment. Distinct namespace (no zic-rs- prefix). Published contract scope: this pins the schema **identity** (the `schema` const) and the top-level object shape. Field-level tightening and full instance-validation against a JSON-Schema validator are a tracked audit-suite item (the core crate carries no validator dependency); see docs/schema-compatibility-policy.md for the versioning rules and tests/schemas.rs for the registry/drift guard.

schema.description: the immutable schema identity; bumped only on a meaning change
